d: Just like THIS! ✨ Finishing my ROV Pilot Technician competency = Dropping the “trainee” title!! 🦾 This trip has been tough. 😅😮‍💨 Out in the heat and humidity. Chasing unusual faults around the ROV. Exposed to so many different issues and scenarios. We ended up getting into parts of the system that people here said they hardly ever need to touch, yet this trip we were in and out of them repeatedly. 🙈 (20-year-old systems, anybody?) As long as the days were, and as steep as the learning curve felt, I wouldn’t have been able to complete my training portfolio without it. I’m incredibly grateful for everything I’ve learnt. The boss says, “Now the real work starts,” as the expectations are higher and there’s much more independence. I’m documenting this like I have every milestone in my career. I’m proud of myself for stepping off the navigational bridge and into the unknown. From submersibles, to AUVs, and now as an ROV Pilot Technician I (R03), I’ve finally achieved the goal I first set for myself back in 2021. Coming from a non-technical background and having to kick HARD just to keep my head above water, it hasn’t been without its challenges. A lot of self-study, plenty of extra reading, and, in the words of my supervisor… “a billion questions.” 😅 Although this is the finish line for one journey, it’s really only the start of a much bigger one. So let this be a reminder that if you really want something, don’t let yourself become the reason you never go after it. “Every version of you that you’ve ever wanted lies just beyond your comfort zone.” #rov #womenoffshore #subsea #offshorelife #careerprogression
zh: 就像这样！完成ROV Pilot Technician能力认证 = 摘掉“学员”头衔！这趟任务很艰难。在高温潮湿的环境下工作，追逐ROV周围不寻常的故障，接触了这么多不同的问题和场景。我们最终处理了一些这里的人说几乎从不碰的系统部分，但这趟任务我们反复进出这些部分。（20年的老系统，谁懂？）尽管日子漫长，学习曲线陡峭，但没有这些我就无法完成培训。对所学一切无比感激。老板说：“真正的工作现在才开始”，期望更高，独立性也更强。我像记录职业生涯每一个里程碑一样记录下这一刻。我为自己从驾驶台走向未知感到骄傲。从潜水器，到AUV，再到如今成为一名ROV Pilot Technician I，我终于实现了2021年为自己设定的目标。来自非技术背景，必须拼命努力才能不被淹没，这一路挑战重重。大量自学、额外阅读，以及用主管的话说……“无数个问题”。这虽然是一段旅程的终点，但其实只是一个更宏大旅程的起点。所以记住：如果你真的想要什么，别让自己成为不去追求的理由。“你想要的每一个版本的自己，都只在舒适区之外。”

d: Would you play a short cosy game? Our Australian made indie game Batography is only fifteen minutes long and is FREE on Steam! d: We have gotten a couple of very sweet comments about the look of our game, and thought it was time to tell you why we decided to give Remaining Grace the look it has now. Only very few 3D games have gone with a handmade look. And we will be one of them!   We’re a small, multicultural indie team with members from all over the world. Wishlists are the most important support for a tiny indie studio like us, so if you like what you see, add Remaining Grace to your wishlist and share it with a friend! 🍃   Follow along as we share development updates, behind-the-scenes content, and more! 🍵   #indiedev #gamedev #indiegames #RemainingGrace
zh: 我们收到了一些关于游戏画面的非常暖心的评论，觉得是时候告诉大家我们为何决定赋予《Remaining Grace》现在的样子了。只有极少数的3D游戏采用手工质感的美术风格。而我们就是其中之一！我们是一个小型的、多元文化的独立团队，成员来自世界各地。将游戏加入愿望单是对于我们这样微小的独立工作室最重要的支持，所以如果你喜欢你所看到的，请将《Remaining Grace》加入愿望单并分享给朋友！ 欢迎关注我们，获取开发更新、幕后内容等更多资讯！

d: I want passion in my indie games. We chose a style that by no means is realistic but hopefully is a bit charming. Sun's Edge has been a multi year passion project that we hope you enjoy. Go wishlist Sun's Edge on Steam! Step into the world of Sun’s Edge, a new action RPG where ancient powers have awoken, monsters roam, and secrets lie buried in the jungle. This gameplay reveal trailer showcases the first look at intense boss fights, open-world exploration, and creature hunting inspired by games like Zelda, Monster Hunter, and Dark Souls. Forge your path through deadly ruins, unlock mythological powers, and battle enemies pulled from Mesoamerican legend. Whether you’re a fan of Breath of the Wild, Elden Ring, or indie gems, Sun’s Edge brings that same sense of danger, mystery, and adventure. #indiedev #gamedev #unreal
zh: 我渴望在独立游戏中看到激情。我们选择了一种绝不写实但希望带点魅力的风格。《Sun's Edge》是一个历时多年的激情项目，希望你们会喜欢。去Steam上将《Sun's Edge》加入愿望单吧！踏入《Sun's Edge》的世界，这是一款全新的动作角色扮演游戏，在这里远古力量已经觉醒，怪物四处游荡，秘密深埋于丛林之中。这部玩法揭露预告片首次展示了激烈的Boss战、开放世界探索，以及受《塞尔达传说》、《怪物猎人》和《黑暗之魂》等游戏启发的生物狩猎。在致命的遗迹中开辟你的道路，解锁神话力量，并与源自中美洲传说的敌人战斗。无论你是《旷野之息》、《艾尔登法环》还是独立精品的粉丝，《Sun's Edge》都能带来同样的危险感、神秘感和冒险感。

Legend says it’s the soul of someone whose burial shroud was never released… trapped, wrapped, and restless. They’re said to hop, not walk — bound by the cloth — appearing pale, bruised, and silent. If you ever hear knocking at night or see one watching from a distance… run. 👻 This clip is going viral right now, and honestly, the movement in the background gave me chills. Real or staged? d: Apa yang dilakukan ketika bertemu @poci di jalan ❔ Jika seseorang tiba‐tiba berpapasan dengan pocong di jalan, terutama pada malam yang sunyi, dipercaya ia tidak boleh lari terburu‐buru. Dalam kepercayaan mistis Jawa, pocong dianggap sebagai roh yang terikat tali kafan karena belum “diantar pulang” sepenuhnya. Ia ingin menunjukkan keberadaannya, bukan sekadar menakuti. Diam sejenak, menundukkan kepala, dan mengucap salam atau doa singkat dipercaya sebagai cara memberi penghormatan kepada roh yang tersesat itu, agar tidak merasa terganggu oleh ketakutan manusia. Konon, jika seseorang langsung berlari tanpa menahan rasa paniknya, roh pocong akan merasa “diikuti” getaran takut itu dan menempel pada tubuh manusia, membuatnya mengalami mimpi buruk atau rasa berat di bagian tertentu ketika bangun tidur. Jika setelah menunduk dan memberi salam, pocong tidak bergerak, cukup mundur perlahan tanpa membelakangi, karena menurut mitos, membelakangi roh berarti membuka punggung untuk “ditunggui”. Barulah setelah jaraknya aman, orang tersebut boleh berbalik dan pergi dengan tenang, sambil berdoa agar roh itu menemukan jalan kembali ke alamnya. .  .  . zh: 如果在路上遇到Pocong该怎么办？如果有人突然在路上与Pocong迎面相遇，尤其是在寂静的夜晚，人们相信他不能匆忙逃跑。在爪哇的神秘信仰中，Pocong被认为是因尚未被完全“送回家”而被寿衣绑绳束缚的灵魂。它想展示自己的存在，而不仅仅是为了吓人。静立片刻，低下头，说一句问候或一段简短的祈祷，被认为是向迷途灵魂致敬的方式，这样它就不会因人类的恐惧而感到不安。据说，如果一个人不克制恐慌直接逃跑，Pocong的灵魂会感到被那股恐惧的振动“跟随”，并附着在人的身体上，导致其做噩梦或醒来时身体某些部位感到沉重。如果低头致意后，Pocong一动不动，只需慢慢后退，不要背对着它，因为根据传说，背对鬼魂意味着敞开后背让它“看管”。直到退到安全距离后，那个人才可以转身平静离开，同时祈祷灵魂能找到回归其世界的路。有人经历过吗？

Reyna applied a traditional coconut oil preparation reported in regional documentation to have protective properties against Aswang contact. d: ‼️FOR SCHOOL PURPOSES KULAM, tagalog word for voodoo or witchcraft and it is one of the most well know aspects of philippine folklore.   kulam or witchcraft can only be done by a person who has knowledge of black magic, we call them MANGKUKULAM. a mangkukulam can be considered as a "filipino witch", literally meaning a "practitioner of kulam". mangkukulam uses black magic that can cause various effect to the victim like illness which cannot be cured with modern medicine, and other unexplained cases. thus, they are feared by the people for their use of black magic. #mythicalcreature #performancetask #mangkukulam
zh: 仅供学术用途。Kulam，菲律宾语中意指巫毒或巫术，是菲律宾民间传说中最广为人知的部分之一。Kulam 或称巫术，只能由掌握黑魔法的人施行，我们称其为巫师。巫师可被视为“菲律宾女巫”，字面意思即“Kulam 的修行者”。巫师使用的黑魔法能对受害者造成多种影响，如现代医学无法治愈的疾病以及其他无法解释的状况。因此，他们因使用黑魔法而备受世人畏惧。

d: POV: The baby is delivered… but still inside a clear, fluid-filled bubble. 👶✨ That’s not a complication. That’s a rare and beautiful moment. This is called an en caul birth 🌊 The newborn emerges completely enclosed within the intact amniotic sac — like a tiny water balloon cradling new life. What happens next? 👇 🩺 The medical team carefully opens the membrane 💧 Amniotic fluid drains 🫁 Air reaches the lungs 👶 First breath. First cry. It looks dramatic — but it’s a natural obstetric variation. High-yield facts 📚 • Extremely rare (more common in preterm births) • Usually seen in cesarean deliveries • The sac protects the baby during birth • Requires swift but gentle membrane rupture after delivery Exam pearl 💡 En caul ≠ complication. It’s simply delivery with intact membranes. A surreal, once-in-a-career moment for many clinicians. ✨ Save this if you love rare obstetric moments 💛 Tag someone fascinated by birth science 👶 #EnCaulBirth #Obstetrics #BirthScience #LaborAndDelivery #MedicalReels #RareBirth #NewbornCare #CSectionBirth #PregnancyEducation #Motherhood #OBGYN #MedStudentLife #DoctorLife #NurseLife #DeliveryRoom #HealthcareEducation #Neonatology #BirthFacts #MedicalKnowledge #FutureDoctor #ClinicalMoments #LifeBegins #MedicineExplained #MaternalHealth #NewLife #HospitalLife #MedEd #BirthAwareness #StayCurious #IncredibleMedicine

zh: POV：宝宝娩出了...但仍在一个透明、充满液体的泡泡里。这不是并发症，而是一个罕见而美丽的时刻。这被称为胎膜完整分娩。新生儿完全包裹在完整的羊膜囊内——就像一个微小的水球承载着新生命。接下来会发生什么？医疗团队小心地打开胎膜，羊水流出，空气进入肺部，第一声呼吸，第一声啼哭。看起来戏剧化，但这是一种自然的产科变异。要点：极其罕见（早产中更常见）；通常见于剖宫产分娩；胎囊在分娩过程中保护婴儿；分娩后需要迅速且轻柔地破膜。考试重点：胎膜完整分娩不等于并发症，它只是胎膜完整的娩出。对许多临床医生来说，这是职业生涯难得的超现实时刻。如果你喜欢罕见的产科瞬间，请收藏。@那些对分娩科学着迷的人。

d: On social media, food challenges have increasingly evolved into direct competitions between individuals, often centered around speed and endurance. In these formats, two or more participants face each other and attempt to consume a specific meal as quickly as possible. The competitive element—who finishes first, who gives up, or who maintains composure under pressure—adds a layer of intensity that strongly appeals to viewers. These time-based challenges are particularly effective in short-form content. The clear objective, combined with a visible countdown or timer, creates immediate suspense. Audiences are drawn into the unfolding race, anticipating the outcome while observing the physical and emotional reactions of the participants. This structure mirrors traditional competitive formats, but in a more casual and accessible setting. Moreover, the interpersonal dynamic plays a crucial role. Unlike solo challenges, head-to-head competitions introduce rivalry, humor, and sometimes playful trash talk. This interaction makes the content more engaging and relatable, as viewers are not only watching the act of eating but also the social exchange between participants. In many cases, creators collaborate, bringing together different audiences and expanding their reach. At the same time, these challenges often escalate in intensity. Larger portions, shorter time limits, or increasingly difficult foods are used to maintain audience interest. While this drives engagement, it also raises concerns about health and the pressure to continuously outperform others for visibility. In essence, time-based food challenges on social media transform eating into a competitive spectacle. They combine clear rules, direct confrontation, and high-paced execution—elements that align perfectly with the demands of modern digital entertainment #food #rockpaperfoodchallenge #foodchallenge #mukbang #buldak
zh: 在社交媒体上，食物挑战已逐渐演变成个人之间的直接比拼，通常围绕速度和耐力展开。两人或多人面对面，看谁最快吃完特定食物。谁先吃完、谁放弃、谁在压力下最淡定——这种竞争元素增添了一层紧张感，对观众极具吸引力。这类限时挑战在短视频中格外有效。清晰的目标加上倒计时或计时器，立刻制造悬念。观众被拉进这场竞赛，猜测结果，同时观察参与者的身体和情绪反应。这种结构类似传统的比赛形式，但场景更随意、易接近。人际互动也至关重要。不同于单人挑战，面对面竞赛带来了对抗、幽默和玩笑互怼。这让内容更有趣、更贴近生活，观众不只看吃东西，还在看参与者之间的社交互动。很多时候，创作者会合作拍视频，融合不同粉丝群体，扩大影响力。同时，挑战难度常会升级。更大的份量、更短的时限或更难下咽的食物，用来维持观众兴趣。这推高了互动数据，但也引发了健康隐忧，以及为博取流量而不断超越他人的压力。本质上，社交媒体的限时食物挑战把“吃”变成了一场竞技表演，融合了清晰规则、直接对抗和高速执行，完美契合现代数字娱乐的需求。

d: Ngaku Gak Jago Masak, Denada Justru Pernah Unjuk Skill di Lomba Masak. Penyanyi Denada Tambunan kembali mencuri perhatian publik lewat konten memasaknya yang viral di media sosial, karena tingkahnya dinilai kikuk, polos, dan kebingungan di dapur. Dalam unggahannya, Denada tampak mengenakan piyama dan melakukan hal-hal sederhana dengan canggung, seperti kesulitan menyalakan kompor, mencuci jamur enoki, hingga merobek sawi. Kehebohan bertambah setelah presenter Sarah Sechan ikut berkomentar dan merasa heran karena teringat Denada pernah terlihat lihai membuat sop ayam di konten lamanya. Pelantun lagu "Sambutlah" itu mengakui bahwa ekspresi bingungnya bukan rekayasa atau gimmick, melainkan karena ia memang tidak berbakat dan memasak bukan passion-nya. Menariknya, netizen kemudian menemukan video lama Denada saat mengikuti kompetisi memasak profesional dalam acara stasiun TV "Perang Dapur". Dalam video tersebut, Denada justru terlihat cukup piawai menggunakan peralatan dapur dan memasak dengan percaya diri. Banyak warganet mempertanyakan apakah ekspresi bingung Denada di dapur, murni nyata atau hanya sekadar gimmick konten demi popularitas. #Denada #Masak #JamanDulu #Sop  #pagipagiambyar
zh: 自称不擅长做饭，Denada却曾在烹饪比赛中展示过厨艺。歌手Denada Tambunan因其在社交媒体上走红的烹饪内容再次引起公众关注，因为她在厨房里显得笨拙、天真和困惑。在她发布的视频中，Denada穿着睡衣，笨拙地做着一些简单的事情，比如点火困难、清洗金针菇，甚至撕白菜。主持人Sarah Sechan也加入评论并感到惊讶，因为她想起Denada在旧内容中曾显得熟练地制作鸡汤。这位演唱"Sambutlah"的歌手承认，她困惑的表情不是设计或噱头，而是她确实没有天赋，烹饪不是她的热情所在。有趣的是，网友随后找到了Denada参加电视台节目"Perang Dapur"专业烹饪比赛的旧视频。在那个视频中，Denada反而显得相当熟练地使用厨房用具并自信地烹饪。许多网友质疑Denada在厨房的困惑表情究竟是真实的还是仅为博取人气的噱头。

Nasi Goreng Indonesia - Indonesian Fried Rice #friedrice #easyrecipes #recipe  Ingredients 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 egg 3 cups cooked rice 4 slices fish cake, thinly sliced 4 large prawns, peeled and deveined A handful of fresh squid, cleaned and sliced 1 tbsp light soy sauce 2 tbsp kecap manis (sweet soy sauce) 1 tsp dark caramel sauce 1 tbsp sambal (adjust to taste) Large pinch of YumYum or MSG 1 bird’s eye chili, finely sliced 1 spring onion, thinly sliced 2 tbsp fried garlic Sliced cucumber and tomato, to serve Fried egg, to serve INSTRUCTIONS 1. Heat a wok over high heat and add a splash of oil. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant. 2. Crack in the egg and scramble it quickly, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks. 3. Add the cooked rice to the wok and toss thoroughly, breaking up any clumps and ensuring it’s well-coated in the egg and garlic mixture. 4. Add the fish cake, prawns, and squid. Toss everything together and stir-fry until the seafood is cooked through. 5. Mix in the light soy sauce, kecap manis, dark caramel sauce, and sambal. Stir well to evenly coat the rice and proteins with the sauce. 6. Toss in the bird’s eye chili and sliced spring onion. Stir-fry briefly to combine. 7. Sprinkle the fried garlic over the rice and give it one final toss. 8. Serve hot, garnished with sliced cucumber and tomato, and top with a fried egg.

Niat membuka usaha di kawasan ikonik Alun-Alun Kidul (Alkid) Yogyakarta justru berujung kecewa. Pemilik kuliner Bolosego, Dyah Laily Fardisa, mengaku terpaksa menghentikan operasional food truck miliknya meski telah mengantongi izin berjualan. Lewat unggahan yang viral di media sosial, Dyah mengungkap adanya sejumlah biaya tambahan yang disebut dibebankan kepadanya. Salah satunya tarif parkir kendaraan operasional yang awalnya diminta mencapai Rp2,5 juta per hari dan setelah negosiasi turun menjadi Rp1 juta. Tak hanya itu, ia juga mengaku diminta menyediakan konsumsi untuk sejumlah orang serta membayar biaya penggunaan listrik.  "Bahkan disuruh memberi makan 10 orang preman lokal hingga memberikan jatah makan gratis untuk tiga oknum polisi," ujar Dyah. Kondisi tersebut dinilai membuat biaya operasional membengkak dan bisnis sulit berjalan. Food truck yang sedianya berjualan selama lima hari itu akhirnya ditutup lebih awal karena pemilik usaha memilih menghindari potensi kerugian. NASI GANDUL 💕 A specialty dish from Pati, Central Java - where my Indonesian grandma is from! This is top-tier street food.  The vendor takes a plate lined with banana leaf, adds hot rice, scissor cuts meat/egg/anything you want on top of the rice, then pours this incredible rich, aromatic, sweet-savory-spicy coconut milk+beef broth soup all over.  SO FREAKIN’ GOOD!!  It’s rare to find Nasi Gandul outside of its originating region, but if you do come across it - try it 😍 #indonesianfood #nasigandul #centraljava #TheMainIngredient #MakanDenganMakna

d: Resep Ayam Goreng Padang (untuk 8 porsi) Bahan marinasi: 2 ekor ayam pejantan utuh 1 buah jeruk nipis bumbu halus Bahan bumbu halus: 6 siung bawang putih 2 sdt ketumbar 4 cm jahe, iris 4 cm kunyit, iris 8 cm lengkuas, iris 5 lembar daun jeruk, buang batang 2 sdt garam 2 sdt kaldu ayam bubuk ¼ sdt merica 1 sdt penyedap 75 gr kelapa parut 4 sdm tepung beras 2 butir telur Bahan sambal cabe ijo: 100 ml minyak 15 siung bawang merah 160 gr cabai hijau, potong 2 buah tomat hijau, iris 5 lembar daun jeruk 1 sdt garam 1 sdt penyedap Pelengkap: nasi putih timun, kupas jeruk nipis Cara membuat: 1. Untuk bumbu halus, siapkan blender dan masukkan bawang putih, ketumbar, jahe, kunyit, lengkuas, daun jeruk, garam, kaldu ayam bubuk, merica, penyedap, kelapa parut, tepung beras dan telur, lalu haluskan 2. Potong ayam menjadi empat bagian dan buang kulitnya. Marinasi ayam dengan perasan jeruk nipis dan bumbu halus, aduk merata. Diamkan minimal 1 jam di suhu ruang atau semalaman di kulkas 3. Goreng ayam yang sudah dimarinasi di minyak panas dengan api sedang hingga matang kecokelatan, angkat dan tiriskan 4. Untuk tambahan serundeng, goreng sisa bumbu marinasi hingga kuning keemasan lalu angkat dan tiriskan 5. Untuk sambal cabe ijo, panaskan minyak sisa menggoreng ayam, lalu masukkan bawang merah dan cabai hijau yang sudah dipotong, tumis hingga layu. Siapkan food chopper dan masukkan tumisan bawang merah dan cabai hijau, lalu haluskan sesaat 6. Tumis tomat hijau dengan minyak sisa tumisan bawang dan cabai. Tambahkan daun jeruk dan bahan sambal yang sudah dihaluskan, tumis sesaat. Tambahkan garam dan penyedap, aduk rata 7. Ayam Goreng Padang siap disajikan

d: Hassle back potatoes with creamy Cajun chicken and airfried brocollini . Easy, healthy comfort meal  Potato recipe 6 medium potatoes 3 tbsp butter (melted) 2 tbsp olive oil 4–5 cloves garlic (minced) 1½ tsp paprika 1½ tsp onion granules 1½ tsp garlic granules 1 tsp dried parsley Salt & pepper 1–2 tsp all-purpose seasoning Method: Slice each potato thinly (don’t cut all the way through). Mix melted butter, olive oil, garlic, and all seasonings. Brush generously over all 6 potatoes, getting into the layers. Air fry at 180°C for 35–45 mins (depending on size). Brush with extra butter halfway through for that crispy finish. Chicken recipe  Ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil 1½ tsp Cajun seasoning ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp onion powder Method: Add the sliced chicken to a bowl. Drizzle over the olive oil. Sprinkle all the seasonings evenly. Mix well until every piece is fully coated. Let it sit for 10–15 minutes (optional, but boosts flavor). Pan-fry on medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Cajun Sauce: 1 tbsp butter ½ onion (diced) 150–200ml heavy cream Same seasonings as chicken Instructions  In the same pan, melt butter and cook onions until soft. Add cream + seasoning, simmer until thickened. Add chicken back in and coat in sauce. #dinnerideas #recipe #easyrecipes #cooking #airfryerrecipe

d: Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi 🍝 Creamy, cozy, and irresistibly delicious gnocchi with tender chicken, sun-dried tomatoes, spinach, and Parmesan😍 All you need is:  •Chicken breast •Gnocchi •Onion •Garlic •Sun-dried tomatoes •Tomato paste •Chicken broth •Heavy cream •Fresh spinach •Parmesan •Olive oil or butter •Salt •Black pepper •Smoked paprika •Dried garlic •Oregano How To Make: 1. Season the chicken breast with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, dried garlic, and oregano. Fry in oil or butter on both sides until golden. Remove, cut into bite-sized pieces, and set aside. 2. In the same pan, sauté finely chopped onion, garlic, and sun-dried tomatoes. Add tomato paste, mix, and cook for about 5 minutes. 3. Pour in the chicken broth. Add the chicken pieces, spinach, and heavy cream. 4. Add the gnocchi and simmer until the gnocchi are tender and the sauce is creamy. 5. Finish with grated Parmesan and serve hot. #marrymechicken #gnocchi #cozydinner #dinnerideas #easydinnerrecipes

d: Fırında beşamel soslu kıymalı makarna 🧀🍝 Malzemeler * 500 g rigatoni makarna * 400 g kıyma * 1 adet soğan * 2 adet biber * 1 dolu yemek kaşığı salça * Tuz * Karabiber ve pul biber * 100 ml su Beşamel sos için * 3 yemek kaşığı tereyağı * 3 yemek kaşığı un * 3-4 su bardağı süt (kıvamına göre değişebilir) * Tuz * Karabiber Üzeri için * Rendelenmiş kaşar peyniri Yapılışı Küp doğradığımız soğan ve biberleri biraz yağda yumuşayana kadar kavuruyoruz. Ardından kıymayı ekleyip güzelce pişiriyoruz. Salçayı, tuzu, karabiberi ve pul biberi ekleyip karıştırıyoruz. Son olarak suyu ilave edip birkaç dakika daha pişiriyoruz. Makarnayı al dente kıvamında haşlayıp süzüyoruz. Beşamel sos için tereyağını eritip unu ekliyoruz ve kokusu çıkana kadar kavuruyoruz. Sütü yavaş yavaş ilave ederek sürekli karıştırıyoruz. Kıvam alınca tuz ve karabiberi ekleyip ocaktan alıyoruz. Videodaki gibi makarnaları kaba yerleştirip, önceden ısıtılmış 180°C fırında, üzeri güzelce kızarana kadar pişiriyoruz. Ortaya nefis, bol soslu ve kaşarlı bir makarna çıkıyor. 🤤🧀  Afiyet olsun! ❤️ #makarna #pasta #yummy #kıymalımakarna

Blender kasar bahan bumbu. 2. Tumis bumbu, tambahkan jahe dan daun jeruk. Tumis hingga tidak langu.  3. Balurkan bumbu ke ayam. Tambahkan kecap, jeruk nipis, lada, dan garam. Diamkan 30 menit. 4. d: Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

d: Recipe by @stephvnietea , I added a little MSG while cooking and WOW 😮‍🔥 This is officially in the dinner rotation.    Ingredients: 1 lb beef flank, sliced into 2-inch pieces 1 large onion, 1/4-inch slices 4–5 green onion stalks, 2–3-inch pieces 4–5 cloves garlic, finely minced 1 tsp ginger, grated Optional: 4–7 dried chilies for spice  Marinade: 3 tbsp cornstarch 1/4 tsp baking soda 1 tbsp shao xing wine (or dry sherry/dry white wine) 1/2 tbsp soy sauce 1/2 tbsp dark soy sauce 1/4 tsp ground white pepper Sauce: 1 tbsp oyster sauce 1/2 tbsp dark soy sauce 1/2 tbsp soy sauce 2 tsp sugar 1 tsp chicken bouillon 1 tsp sesame oil (or to taste) 1/2 tsp white or black pepper 1/3 cup cooking oil (for shallow fry) Directions: 1-Marinate beef with cornstarch, baking soda, shao xing wine, soy sauces, and white pepper for 15 mins. 2-Combine sauce ingredients and set aside. 3-Heat 1/3 cup oil in a wok. Add beef, spread evenly, cook 2–3 mins per side for a crust. (Here I added a little MSG!) 4-Strain beef from oil and set aside. 5-Leave 2–3 tbsp oil in wok, cook ginger, garlic, and dried chilies until fragrant. 6-Add onions, cook 2–3 mins until barely translucent. 7-Return beef, add sauce, toss evenly for 2 mins. 8-Top with green onions, toss once more, serve with steamed rice. #mongolianbeef #dinnerideas #recipe #cooking #easyrecipe

d: One-Pan Steak, Roasted Potatoes, Eggs & Chimichurri Sauce! Full recipe on my Substack - link in bio I started by roasting halved potatoes in a PFAS-free pan until golden and crispy. While the potatoes were cooking, I made a classic chimichurri and seasoned a Black Angus entrecôte with a chimichurri rub. The steak was grilled over blazing hot cast iron, sliced and added back to the pan. Five eggs were cracked alongside the potatoes, then everything was finished with a generous drizzle of fresh chimichurri. d: One of Thailand’s most famous dishes and I Couldn’t stop eating this when I was over there so I had to recreate it at home to  best ofmy abilities. Spicy, fragrant and absolutely delicious. 📝INGREDIENTS  -jasmine rice  -pork/beef/ chicken mince and for one serving I used around 250-300g  -Thai holy basil *I got mine from a international food shop. Shoutout @mattas1984 ( if you can’t source it Thai basil is a good alternative but remember it’s not the same , I’ve also seen people use 80% Italian basil and 20% mint with a pinch of clove) For the sauce I liked mine a bit darker so you don’t have to use these exact measurements, once you use the fish, oyster and soy sauce you’re on the right track. I’ve even some places use chicken stock and they have the meat more soft than crispy , it’s really down to you. -2tsp fish sauce  -optionally a tsp of light soy  -1tsp dark soy -2tsp of oyster sauce  -6 garlic  -7-9 Thai red chillies if you want it spicy , 3-4 if you want it mild. If you can’t get Thai red chillies , normal red chillies can be used. -cooking oil  -shallots  -fried egg  -green beans  As always in my videos I just get ingredients that aren’t pricey and I always get them from Aldi/Lidil/Asda , Asian markets near me or Amazon. Follow for more naasty recipes if you enjoy or watch the longer more in depth versions of my videos on my YouTube channel 👍✅ #padkrapao #thaïfood #thaicooking #holybasil #staynaasty
zh: 泰国最著名菜肴之一 在那边时根本停不下来 所以在家也尽力复刻 香辣浓郁 绝对美味 📝食材 -茉莉香米 -猪肉/牛肉/鸡肉末 一人份约250-300克 -泰国圣罗勒 *我在国际食品店买的 感谢@mattas1984 (如果买不到 泰国罗勒是不错的替代 但记住味道不同 我也见过有人用80%意大利罗勒和20%薄荷加少许丁香) 酱汁方面 我喜欢颜色深一点 所以不必完全照用这些分量 只要用了鱼露 蚝油和酱油就成功大半了 我甚至见有些地方加鸡汤 肉做得软嫩而非干香 全看个人喜好 -2茶匙鱼露 -可选1茶匙生抽 -1茶匙老抽 -2茶匙蚝油 -6瓣大蒜 -想吃辣就放7-9根泰国小红椒 微辣就3-4根 如果买不到泰式小红椒 普通红辣椒也行 -食用油 -红葱头 -煎蛋 -豆角 如往常 我在视频里全都用不太贵的食材 常从Aldi/Lidl/Asda 附近亚洲超市或亚马逊买 喜欢的话关注看更多重口味食谱 也可去我YouTube频道看更长更详细的视频版本

d: ✨Thai food, but make it brunch 👀✨ I finally checked out @VeLa Brunch&Thai , a modern Thai spot in Downtown San Jose that serves both brunch and dinner. d: このエビマヨまっっじで美味しかったので絶対に作ってみてほしい🍤 フリッター衣がサクッカリッで最高すぎた！ ▽材料(2人前) ＊冷凍エビ200g (12尾) ＊ソース[A] ・マヨネーズ大さじ3 ・牛乳、ケチャップ、はちみつ各小さじ1 ・レモン汁小さじ1/2 ＊フリッター衣[B] ・薄力粉大さじ4 ・片栗粉大さじ2 ・水大さじ4 ・マヨネーズ大さじ1 ・ベーキングパウダー3g ・塩ひとつまみ . ▽作り方 ①冷凍エビ200gを塩水で解凍しておく . ② この間にソース[A]マヨネーズ大さじ3、牛乳・ケチャップ・はちみつ各小さじ1、レモン汁小さじ1/2を混ぜ合わせておく . ③ フリッター衣[B]薄力粉大さじ4、片栗粉大さじ2、水大さじ4、マヨネーズ大さじ1、ベーキングパウダー3g、塩ひとつまみを合わせておく(結構もったり感あります) . ④油はねの原因になるのでエビの水気はしっかり拭いておく。衣をまとわせて170度の油できつね色になるまで揚げる . ⑤最後にエビマヨソースと絡めたら完成！ . #おうちごはん #簡単レシピ #料理 #エビマヨ #crispy

zh: 这款蛋黄酱虾仁真的太好吃了，请一定试试看 油炸面糊酥脆至极，超棒！ 材料（2人份） 冷冻虾仁200g（12只） 酱汁[A]：蛋黄酱3大勺，牛奶、番茄酱、蜂蜜各1小勺，柠檬汁½小勺 油炸面糊[B]：低筋面粉4大勺，土豆淀粉2大勺，水4大勺，蛋黄酱1大勺，泡打粉3g，盐一撮 做法： ①冷冻虾仁200g用盐水解冻 ②期间混合酱汁[A]：蛋黄酱3大勺，牛奶、番茄酱、蜂蜜各1小勺，柠檬汁½小勺 ③混合油炸面糊[B]：低筋面粉4大勺，土豆淀粉2大勺，水4大勺，蛋黄酱1大勺，泡打粉3g，盐一撮（面糊会偏稠） ④为防止溅油，仔细擦干虾仁水分。裹上面糊，放入170度油中炸至金黄 ⑤最后与蛋黄酱汁拌匀即可！ .

d: Tried and true recipe! The perfect recipe to satisfy your takeout craving 😋 ➡️ Recipe: Beijing Beef  Serves 3-4 * 1lb skirt steak or flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain  * 1 small red bell pepper, large diced  * 1 medium onion, large diced  * 4-5 garlic cloves, finely minced  * 1 tsp grated ginger  * Frying oil  Beef marinade— * 1/2 cup cornstarch  * 2 tbsp water (add an extra 1/2tbsp if needed  * 1 tsp sesame oil  * 1/2 tsp garlic powder * 1/4 tsp baking soda  * 1/4 tsp kosher salt  * 1/8 tsp white or black pepper  Sauce— * 3 tbsp rice vinegar or 2 tbsp white vinegar  * 2 tbsp oyster sauce  * 2 tbsp ketchup  * 1 tbsp hoisin sauce  * 1 1/2 tbsp soy sauce  * 1 1/2 tbsp sugar  * 1/2-1 tsp chili flakes (optional)  1. In a bowl, combine sesame, oil, garlic powder, baking soda, kosher salt, and white pepper with flank steak. Mix well then add cornstarch and water, mix until the meat is craggly and set aside.  2. In a small bowl, combine vinegar, oyster sauce, ketchup, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and chili flakes. Mix well and set aside.  3. In a large pan, heat enough oil for a shallow fry to 350°F. Carefully place marinated beef to fry and ensure each slice does not stick together for an even fry. Fry for 3-4 mins or until beef is cooked through and coated and crispy. Strain the beef and set aside. 4. In a large wok, heat 1-2 tbsp oil. Add onions and bell peppers sauté for 30 seconds or just before it turns translucent. Then add garlic and ginger and sauté for another 30 secs-1 min. 5. Make a pit in the center and pour all of the sauce. Toss with onions and bell peppers for about. Then add the fried beef. Toss until everything is combined and evenly coated with the sauce. Serve and enjoy!  #easyrecipes #chinesefood #beijingbeef #dinnerideas #takeout
zh: 久经考验的食谱！满足外卖瘾的完美配方 😋 食谱：京酱牛肉 3-4人份 * 1磅牛裙肉或牛侧腹肉，逆纹切薄片 * 1个小红甜椒，切大丁 * 1个中号洋葱，切大丁 * 4-5瓣大蒜，切细末 * 1茶匙姜蓉 * 炸油 牛肉腌料：* ½杯玉米淀粉 * 2汤匙水（必要时可多加½汤匙） * 1茶匙芝麻油 * ½茶匙蒜粉 * ¼茶匙小苏打 * ¼茶匙粗盐 * ⅛茶匙白胡椒粉或黑胡椒粉 酱汁：* 3汤匙米醋或2汤匙白醋 * 2汤匙蚝油 * 2汤匙番茄酱 * 1汤匙海鲜酱 * 1½汤匙酱油 * 1½汤匙糖 * ½-1茶匙辣椒碎（可选） 1. 在碗中，将芝麻油、蒜粉、小苏打、粗盐和白胡椒粉与牛肉片混合。拌匀后加入玉米淀粉和水，搅拌至肉片挂上粗糙的面糊，放置一旁。 2. 在小碗中，混合醋、蚝油、番茄酱、海鲜酱、酱油、糖和辣椒碎。拌匀待用。 3. 在大平底锅中，加热足量油至350°F，用于浅炸。小心放入腌好的牛肉，确保每片不粘连，以便受热均匀。炸3-4分钟或至牛肉熟透、表面酥脆。捞出牛肉沥油，待用。 4. 用大炒锅加热1-2汤匙油。加入洋葱和甜椒，翻炒30秒或至其刚变半透明。接着加入蒜末和姜蓉，再炒30秒至1分钟。 5. 在锅中扒开一个空位，倒入所有酱汁。与洋葱和甜椒翻炒片刻。然后加入炸好的牛肉。翻炒至所有材料均匀裹上酱汁。装盘享用！

d: 🇵🇭 Pork Adobo | Filipino Food Bible – Episode 1 My take on one of the most iconic Filipino dishes - Pork Adobo! This series will feature all filipino dishes in all their variations. consider this your guide to filipino cuisine. comment what you wanna see next! INGREDIENTS: Pork Adobo - 1.2 kg pork belly (or cut of choice) - 15–20 cloves garlic, minced (adjust to taste—more is always welcome) - 1 onion, chopped - 500 ml pork broth - 190 ml soy sauce - 100 ml cane vinegar - 3 long green chilies - 4 bay leaves - 1 tbsp whole peppercorns - 30 g palm sugar, chopped (adjust to sweetness) - Oil, for frying Toppings - Sliced onion leeks - Crispy garlic bits - Boiled eggs INSTRUCTIONS - Fry the pork until lightly browned on all sides, then remove and set aside. - In the same pot, sauté the garlic until lightly golden and fragrant. Add onions and cook until softened. - Return the pork to the pot, pour in the pork broth. Add the soy sauce, vinegar, green chilies, bay leaves, peppercorns, and palm sugar.  - Cover and let simmer on medium heat for 5-10 mins **don’t mix to allow vinegar to cook.  - Turn to low heat for 1–2 hours, until the pork is tender and the sauce has reduced. you want it to be almost swimming in its own fat like a confit - Optional: If serving with eggs, add the soft boiled eggs 2-3 mins before serving to retain jammyness - Serve over hot rice, topped with crispy garlic and leeks, and a hard-boiled egg on the side. Enjoy. #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr #pinoyfood

d: 🇵🇭 Ginisang Munggo v1.0  | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 15 Ginisang munggo is one of those Filipino dishes that can look completely different depending on who’s cooking it. Some keep it simple, some add tinapa, but for my version today, I’m throwing etag into the mix. Etag is a traditional Cordilleran preserved pork, usually salted then air-dried or smoked. It has a deeply savory, smoky, slightly funky flavor that adds a lot of flavor to soups and stews. Highly recommend this to you guys! Most measurements are estimates. Season and adjust to your liking :) INGREDIENTS: Ginisang Munggo: - 500g munggo, soaked and boiled - 1 1/2  cup etag, chopped - 250g of shrimp - 15-20 cloves of garlic, chopped - 1-2 red onions, chopped - 350g Cherry tomatoes - Pork broth as needed - Chicharon to taste - Fish sauce, adjust to taste - 3-5 Green chilies, adjust to spice  - 1 large ampalaya - 3-4 handfuls ampalaya tops - 3-4 handfuls alugbati  INSTRUCTIONS: - Soak the munggo in water for an hour or overnight, then drain. Transfer to a pot, cover with fresh water, and boil for 30 minutes or until slightly tender. - Add the etag to a pot and slowly render out  its fat. Add the garlic and onions, then sauté until softened. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook them down until soft and jammy. - Add in the cooked munggo followed by the pork broth, shrimp and chicharron, then season with fish sauce and mix and let simmer for a 5-10 minutes. - Add the ampalaya, green chili, and leafy greens toward the end. Mix everything together and let cook for aroujnd 3-4 mins - Serve and enjoy! #FilipinoFood #Filipino #ASMR #CookingASMR

d: 🇵🇭 Kare Kare | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 10 Kare-kare is a rich Filipino stew made with oxtail, tripe, and vegetables, all simmered in a thick peanut sauce. It’s usually served with bagoong (fermented shrimp paste) on the side to balance the flavors and an extra level of umami and saltiness 😋 INGREDIENTS: Boiling liquid: - 1-2 red onions, chopped - 2 bulbs of garlic, chopped - 1 tbsp of salt - 1 tbsp peppercorns - 5-6 bay leaves - 1 kg of oxtail - 650g of ox tripe - Beef stock as needed Kare Kare: - 10g of annatto powder - 2 tablespoons oil - 15-20 cloves garlic, minced - 2 tbsp annatto powder - 1 white onion, diced - 1 banana heart, chopped, washed and rinsed w/ salt - Beef stock as needed - green beans, chopped - eggplants, quartered - pechay/bok choy - 1 ½ cup peanut butter - Patis to taste - ½ teaspoon salt - 1 tbsp of sugar (optional to taste) Toasted rice slurry: - 1:5 tbsp of water to toasted rice, blended Served with:  - Bagoong  - Crushed peanuts INSTRUCTIONS:  - Start by seasoning your meat with salt and pepper and sear. Add all ingredients under “boiling liquid” and fill the pot as needed with beef stock. Simmer until tender, remove meat and set aside the broth for later.  - Saute onions, garlic, and banana hearts in oil mixed with annatto powder. Add your meat back and cover with the broth from the boiling liquid and simmer for 15-20 minutes. - To thicken the mixture, add toasted rice to a food processor or blender. Take some of the rice and mix with water to form our slurry.  - Add both rice slurry and peanut butter stir and reduce to thicken. Season with patis/salt/pepper and add your vegetables.  - Serve alongside bagoong top and enjoy!  #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #PinoyFood

d: Episode 5: Homemade Garlic Longganisa 🇵🇭 (Pinoy-Style) Ingredients:  900 g ground pork 150 g pork fat (optional) 20 cloves garlic, finely minced 1/4 cup brown sugar 1 1/2 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp white vinegar 1 tsp paprika 2 tbsp cornstarch 1 tbsp salt 1 tbsp black pepper Natural hog casing  Kitchen twine Procedure:  1. Rinse and soak the hog casing in water for 1 minute. Drain well. 2. Mix the ground pork, garlic, sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, salt, pepper, paprika, cornstarch, and cold water until sticky and well combined. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours 3. Stuff the mixture into the casing, being careful not to overfill. Twist and tie with kitchen twine. 4. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight to slightly dry the casing. Then freeze overnight. 4. To cook, place the longganisa in a pan with ¼ cup water. Cover and cook over medium heat until the water evaporates. Add 1–2 tbsp oil and fry until golden brown and cooked through, reaching 71°C / 160°F internally. You can add any seasoning but make sure you mix it well with the meat! Pwede adobo flavor or any. Enjoy my recipe and tag me pag nakagawa na kayo! ☺️ #ChefYlyt #privatechef #easyrecipes #homemade #longganisa

d: 🇵🇭 Ilocos Empanada | Filipino Food Bible Episode 4 A crispy pocket of goodness filled with sausage, egg and papaya originating from Ilocos in the northern region of the Philippines. Many variations exist but this is my take inspired by both the Vigan and Batac versions! note: adjust ratios of water/flour depending on flour brand since absorption rates may vary. Measurements are weighed but adjust to your preference! INGREDIENTS: Vigan Longganisa/sausage: - 1kg ground pork - 170g of garlic, minced - 80 ml spiced cane vinegar - 80 ml soy sauce - 2-3 tsp of ground black pepper - 1 tbsp of brown sugar - Salt to taste - pinch of MSG Spiced Vinegar: - 15-20 cloves garlic - 3 green chili - 9 birds eye chili - 15 shallots - 700 ml cane vinegar - 1 tbsp freshly cracked black pepper - 1 tsp salt - 30 ml fish sauce Dough (Yield 7-8 ~110g per ball): - 340g rice flour - 2 cups water - pinch of salt - 1 1/2 tbsp of chicken powder - 2 1/2 tbsp of annatto powder - 4 tbsp oil  Filling: - 2:1 ratio shredded green papaya to mung beans - salt/pepper to taste INSTRUCTIONS:  - for spiced vinegar blend together all ingredients under "spiced vinegar”. set aside - For the sausage, combine all ingredients listed under "Vigan longganisa” mix and let sir for 1hr - overnight  . Sear until rendered and crispy. - soak beans for about 1-2 hrs. Drain and boil for ~15mins until soft. - Shred papaya, add salt. squeeze water out. Combine w/ munggo and season w salt and pepper. - For the dough combine annatto powder, oil, salt, chicken powder and water. Boil and add to flour. knead until the texture resembles clay. you can combine w/ flour directly on stovetop. - roll ball of dough between cut plastic until thin - In the center place your papaya mixture and form a small hollow circle. add sausage, and egg at the center - Fold, tuck in the sides, and cut excess dough using a plate. Fry at 165C until crispy - Serve w/ spiced vinegar and enjoy! #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr

d: One of the biggest misconceptions about Filipino food is that it's all unhealthy. It's all brown, fried, fatty and salty. You know, the party foods? But it's far from the truth. There are plenty of "Lutong-bahay" or homestyle Filipino dishes that are nutrient-dense like "LASWA". It's an Ilongo vegetable soup dish that consists of a variety of exotic vegetables like eggplant, long beans or sitaw, kobucha squash or kalabasa, sponge gourd or patola, spinach, etc. Shrimp for protein is added and just salt for seasoning. Simple yet comforting and grabe, ang sarap! #filipino #filipinofood #filipinorecipe #foodtok #vegetables

d: 🇵🇭 La Paz Batchoy | Soups So Good It Can Cure Any Sickness Ep. 31 My take on one of the Philippines most beloved noodle soups. Originating from the La Paz  district of Iloilo CIty it grew from a humble market meal into one of Iloilo’s most recognizable dishes! It’s rich, garlicky and delicious and probably one of my favorite noodle soups of all time *most ingredients are estimates since I cook and season mostly by feel so taste and season as you cook to fit your taste! :) INGREDIENTS: Kaldo / Broth: - 2 kg pork bones - 2 kg beef marrow bones - 1kg pork shoulder, kasim, or pork belly - 2 onions, roughly chopped - 4 heads garlic, halved - 2 green onion, roughly chopped - 1 tbsp peppercorns - water as needed - 1/4 cup ginamos or to taste - Salt/patis, to taste - 2-3 tsp sugar, optional Meat Toppings: - pork liver, sliced - Cooked pork shoulder, sliced Noodles & Toppings: - miki/egg noodles - crushed chicharon -  toasted garlic - spring onions - Egg yolk - Roasted Bone marrow INSTRUCTIONS: - add your pork bones and beef marrow bones to a large pot and blanch for 10 minutes. Discard water and rinse the bones before adding them back into the pot with the onions, garlic, leek, and peppercorns. Fill w/ water and simmer for 8 hours, or overnight for the best results. - Once the stock is ready, remove bones, add guinamos to a strainer lined optionally with cheese cloth and strain soup for a silkier texture. add soup back to pot -  add your pork shoulder and simmer for around 45 minutes - In a separate pot, sauté some garlic until lightly toasted before adding your broth. Season with more guinamos if needed, sugar, and fish sauce to taste. Optionally you can blend this broth along with bone marrow if you want an extra rich soup. - Add the pork liver to the reserved broth and gently simmer until fully cooked through. Avoid overcooking it so the liver stays tender. Remove and slice let it rest before slicing thinly along with pork shoulder. - Slice cooked pork and liver. - Serve with noodles, hot broth, sliced pork/ and liver, crispy garlic, spring onions scallions, crushed chicharon, an egg yolk, and ea piece of bone marrow. Enjoy! #Soups #Soup #asmr #asmrcooking

d: Ginataang Manok  Ingredients: 4 Chicken thighs and 4-6 drumsticks Kosher salt for seasoning the chicken 1/2 onion, sliced 3 cloves garlic, minced 3/4 Cup water 2 Cans coconut milk 1 Anaheim Pepper 3 Fresno chillies (optional) use 1-2 Thai chili if you like it spicy 1 Chicken Bouillon Cube 1 Tbsp Black pepper 1 Tbsp Fish sauce 40g Ginger, cut in slices 1 Large potato 1 Large Carrot Bok Choy Instructions 1. Season the chicken generously with kosher salt. For the best flavor, refrigerate and let it season overnight. 2. Heat a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken skin-side down until golden brown and the fat has rendered, about 5–7 minutes. Flip and cook for 1 more minute, then remove from the pot. 3. In the same pot, sauté the onions for 2–3 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. 4. Pour in the water and coconut milk, then stir in the ginger, bouillon cube, fish sauce, and black pepper. Return the chicken to the pot. 5. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered over medium-low heat for 15 minutes. 6. Add the potatoes, carrots, and Fresno chilies (if using). Continue simmering for another 15 minutes, or until the vegetables are fork-tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. 7. Taste the broth and adjust the seasoning if needed. 8. Serve hot with steamed white rice. #ginataangmanok #filipino #recipe #food #easyrecipe

d: Chicken Kinamatisan (Chicken Tomato Stew) 1 kilo chicken thigh and leg pieces salt and pepper 2-3 tbsp cooking oil 4 cloves garlic, chopped 1 medium onion, chopped 1/2 kilo tomatoes, chopped 2 tbsp fish sauce 1-2 cups water 1 large potato, diced 3 bunches pechay or bokchoy salt to taste Season the chicken with 1/2 tsp salt and pepper making sure to massage each pieces well. Marinate for about 30 minutes.  Heat some oil in a pan, then sear the chicken until golden brown on both sides. Set the chicken aside.  Using the same pan, sauté the garlic until frgrant and add the onion and sauté until translucent. Then add the tomatoes and season with fish sauce. Continue cooking until the tomatoes are soften and release their juices.  Return the chicken to the pan and toss until well combined. Pour in the water, cover and simmer for about 30 minutes or until the chicken is tender.  Add the potatoes and simmer for another 10 minutes. Season with salt to taste.  Finally, add the bokchoy and simmer for another 3-5 minutes or until wilted. Serve and enjoy with warm rice! #ChickenKinamatisan #ChickenTomatoStew
zh: 番茄酱鸡（番茄炖鸡） 1公斤鸡大腿和鸡小腿 盐和胡椒 2-3汤匙食用油 4瓣蒜，切碎 1个中号洋葱，切碎 1/2公斤番茄，切碎 2汤匙鱼露 1-2杯水 1个大土豆，切丁 3把小白菜或上海青 盐调味 用1/2茶匙盐和胡椒腌制鸡肉，确保涂抹均匀。腌制约30分钟。锅中倒油烧热，将鸡肉煎至两面金黄。盛出备用。同一锅中爆香蒜末，加入洋葱炒至透明。然后加入番茄，用鱼露调味。继续煮至番茄变软出汁。将鸡肉放回锅中，翻炒均匀。加水，盖上锅盖炖煮约30分钟或至鸡肉软烂。加入土豆再炖10分钟。加盐调味。最后加入上海青，再炖3-5分钟或至菜叶变软。盛出，搭配热米饭享用！

Slice them into bite sized chunks and set aside for later - Slice button mushrooms. In a pan , add oil and/or butter, sauté the button mushrooms until they get deeper in color. Season with salt and pepper.  - Add minced garlic to a hot pan with oil and butter, and saute unti fragrant. Add back your steak and mushroom and add Worcestershire sauce, oyster sauce, paprika and black pepper. - To make it extra garlicky, we’re adding some garlic confit. To make it, simply add peeled garlic to a pot, cover with oil, and cook low and slow until the cloves are soft and golden. - Serve with garlic rice and enjoy! #CookingASMR #ASMR # FilipinoFood #pinoyfood

🇵🇭🍗 Max’s Style Fried Chicken INGREDIENTS: *some measurements may be estimates only so season and adjust to your liking 🙏🫶 Chicken Marinade: - 6pcs chicken leg quarter - 1/4 cup patis - 1/4 cup ml of calamansi - 10 cloves of garlic, minced Chicken blanching liquid: - 3 onions, chopped - 3 heads garlic, halved - 1 stalk of cilantro/wansoy - ¼ cup of calamansi juice - 3-4 bay leaves  - ¼ cup of peppercorn - ¼ cup of patis - 1-2 sachets of Maggi Magic Sarap - marinating liquid - Water as needed Chicken Drying: - 1 sachet of Maggi Magic Sarap - 1 tsp of baking powder Chicken Frying: - Oil as needed Sweet Potato Fries: - 6 sweet potatoes, fries cut - Water as needed - ⅓ cup of white vinegar - 1/4 cup of flour - ¼ cup of cornstarch - ¼ cup of rice flour - 1 tsp of baking powder - 1 tsp of baking soda - Water from soaking - Oil Dipping: - Banana Ketchup - Worcestershire sauce INSTRUCTIONS - Marinate the chicken w/ all ingredients under “marinade”. Set aside for 2hrs-overnight. - Transfer the chicken to a pot and add all the ingredients under “Chicken Boiling Liquid.” Pour in enough water to cover most of the chicken, low simmer for around 15 mins. - Combine the Maggi Magic Sarap and baking powder, then season the chicken evenly. dry in fridge overnight uncovered. - Soak sweet potatoes in water and vinegar. Reserve some soaking water before draining. Combine the potatoes, flour, cornstarch, rice flour, baking powder, and baking soda. add a little reserved soaking liquid to create a light batter. deep fry at 165°C for 4-5mins or until crisp. - For the dipping sauce, combine the banana ketchup and Worcestershire sauce. - Serve fried chicken with rice, sweet potato fries, and dipping sauce. d: There is nothing easier than making this kakanin recipe. 🍢 We’re making karioka on our 10th day for this series and it’s just gonna keep getting better from here! 🔥  Karioka is a simple yet flavorful snack that’s usually found along the busy streets of the city which is why it’s a nostalgic treat for many Filipinos. Try this at home today! 🤤  KARIOKA Ingredients: 2-¼ cups glutinous rice flour ½ cup niyog, pressed 1 tbsp sugar ½ tsp salt 1-¼ cups coconut milk 2 cups brown sugar Procedure: 1. In a bowl, combine flour, niyog, sugar, and salt.  2. Mix in coconut milk and knead until you form a smooth dough. 3. Portion into 1 inch balls and in hot oil over medium heat, fry for 1-½ minutes. Be careful as each ball might puff while frying.  4. Skewer 3 balls in each stick then in a pan, melt your sugar. d: Fall Gameday Comfort Food Series Part 1: Honey Chipotle Fried Chicken Mac & Cheese Recipe👇: Ingredients • Chicken breast • Hot sauce • Pickle juice • Buttermilk • PoggioliEats Cajun Seasoning • Potato starch • Flour • Frying oil • Honey chipotle sauce • Butter • Evaporated milk • Whole milk • Heavy cream • Mustard • Cheddar • Gruyère • Mozzarella • Oaxaca • Monterey Jack • Pasta shells • Paprika • Ranch • Parsley Instructions 1. Marinate the chicken in hot sauce, pickle juice, buttermilk and PoggioliEats Cajun Seasoning. 2. Mix 2 parts potato starch with 1 part flour and more Cajun seasoning. Coat the chicken and fry until crispy and cooked through. Toss in honey chipotle sauce. 3. Melt butter, stir in flour and Cajun seasoning, then gradually add evaporated milk, whole milk and heavy cream. Once thickened, stir in hot sauce and mustard. 4. Melt in cheddar, Gruyère, mozzarella, Oaxaca and Monterey Jack. Fold in the cooked shells. 5. Add half the mac and cheese to a baking dish, layer with cheese, then add the rest. Top with cheddar and paprika and bake at 325°F until hot and bubbly. 6. Serve the mac and cheese topped with honey chipotle chicken, ranch and parsley. #chicken #cheese #chipotle #dinner #recipe
zh: 秋季比赛日治愈美食系列 第一部分：蜂蜜墨西哥辣椒炸鸡芝士通心粉 食谱👇： 食材 • 鸡胸肉 • 辣酱 • 腌黄瓜汁 • 酪乳 • PoggioliEats卡真调味料 • 马铃薯淀粉 • 面粉 • 炸油 • 蜂蜜墨西哥辣椒酱 • 黄油 • 淡奶 • 全脂牛奶 • 重奶油 • 芥末 • 切达干酪 • 格鲁耶尔干酪 • 马苏里拉奶酪 • 瓦哈卡奶酪 • 蒙特里杰克奶酪 • 通心粉 • 红辣椒粉 • 牧场沙拉酱 • 欧芹 步骤 1. 用辣酱、腌黄瓜汁、酪乳和PoggioliEats卡真调味料腌制鸡肉。 2. 将2份马铃薯淀粉与1份面粉和更多卡真调味料混合。将鸡肉裹上面衣，炸至酥脆熟透。裹上蜂蜜墨西哥辣椒酱。 3. 融化黄油，拌入面粉和卡真调味料，然后逐渐加入淡奶、全脂牛奶和重奶油。变浓稠后，拌入辣酱和芥末。 4. 融化切达干酪、格鲁耶尔干酪、马苏里拉奶酪、瓦哈卡奶酪和蒙特里杰克奶酪。拌入煮好的通心粉。 5. 将一半的芝士通心粉放入烤盘，铺上一层奶酪，再加入剩下的通心粉。顶部撒上切达干酪和红辣椒粉，在325°F（约163°C）下烘烤至热且冒泡。 6. 芝士通心粉上放蜂蜜墨西哥辣椒炸鸡，淋上牧场沙拉酱和欧芹，即可上桌。

d: Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Hot Honey Chicken Pasta 🍯🔥 the viral recipe with over 60+ million views, 20/10 hits every time! Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Add mozzarella and Parmesan until melted and creamy, then toss in cooked pasta. 6. Top creamy pasta with hot honey chicken and extra sauce if desired and enjoy :) #hothoneychickenpasta #hothoney #chickenpasta #pasta #fypシ

d: 💥bang bang chicken 🍗 Ingredients  1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs season to your hearts desire  salt and pepper onion powder  garlic powder  smoked paprika  Sauce 1/2 cup Kewpie mayo @Kewpieusa  3 tbsp sweet chili sauce  Sriracha to taste  1/2 tbsp lime juice  Instructions  1. Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. Cook until the thickest part of the chicken reaches internal temp of 165°F. 3. While chicken is cooking make the bang bang sauce. Reserve some sauce for topping. Brush remaining sauce to coat top of each chicken thigh. Crank heat up to 400°F or if you have the @From Our Place air fryer like me, switch it to low broil. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until sauce thickens.  4. Serve with rice, garnish with reserved sauce, parsley or chopped green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

Replying to @Just a shifter!<3  Welcome to my fall soup series 🍲🍁🍂 Below is the recipe to this DELICIOUS marry me chicken gnocchi soup 🤭  Ingredients:  Chicken Breasts 1 tsp Salt Pepper 1 1/2 tsp Garlic Powder 1 tsp Onion Powder 2 tbsp Paprika 1 tsp Chilli Powder 1 tsp Slap ya mama seasoning 1/2 tsp Cayenne pepper  1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tbsp Adobo sauce  3 cups Low Sodium Chicken Broth 1 1/2 cup Heavy Cream 2 cups Parmesean cheese  Basil 1/2 White onion 1 tbsp Minced garlic  3 tbsp Olive Oil Cherry tomatoes  Gnocchi  Instructions: 1. To a bowl pour in olive oil, adobo sauce, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, chilli powder, paprika. Mix, add in chicken breast and incorporate. Set aside for 30 mins 2. Cook chicken breast on medium heat until slightly charred, set aside, and shred once slightly cooled down.  3. In the same pot, add in diced onions, minced garlic, cherry tomatoes, and basil. Let cook until tomatoes are soft and then lightly mash them with spoon.  4. Pour in chicken broth and let boil before adding in gnocchi and let cook for about 4 minutes.  5. Pour in heavy cream and season with salt, onion powder, garlic powder, chilli powder, slap ya mama seasoning, cayenne powder, pepper, and paprika.  6. Allow to boil and pour in parmesean cheese. Mix well and let cook for about 2 minutes.  7. Pour in shredded chicken, mix well and add basil. Cover pot and let cook on low heat for about 5 minutes  8. Serve garnished with Parmesan cheese and basil, and enjoy :) #marrymechicken #gnocchi #soup #fallsoup #foodcreator

Cajun butter steak bites over parmesan mashed potatoes🥩🧈 recipe below: Cajun butter🧈 -4 tbsp unsalted softened butter  -1/2 tsp seasoned Cajun -1 tsp parsley -2 tsp minced garlic  -1 tsp lemon juice -1/2 tsp Dijon mustard  Mix until combined (optional: add red pepper flakes for spice) Cajun steak bites🥩 -trim 2 steaks of choice into 1 inch pieces -season with 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and 1 tsp buttery steakhouse seasoning -let steaks rest before cooking to avoid chewy steak bites ** -cook in avocado oil on med/high heat -flip after 1-2 minutes  -reduce heat and stir in 2 tbsp Cajun butter -toss steak bites 1 additional minute  -remove steak and add asparagus  -season asparagus with lemon juice, garlic powder, salt, pepper, & Parmesan  creamy Parmesan mashed potatoes🥔 -peel 2 large gold potatoes  -dice into 1 inch cubes  -boil in salted water -drain water and mash -stir in 1/2 cup heavy cream, 2 tbsp sour cream, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, 1/2 tbsp butter, salt, pepper, & garlic powder  Assembly✨ -Add creamy Parmesan mashed potatoes to a bowl and top with Cajun butter steak bites🥩 Serve with asparagus, ciabatta, & garnish with parsley  #cooking #foodtiktok #fyp  #creatorsearchinsights #whatdoimakefordinner

Crispy Breakfast Quesadilla crispy, cheesy & loaded! 🌮🍳🥓 This Breakfast Quesadilla is the ultimate morning bite!  Ingredients ½ cup shredded cheddar cheese, divided 2 large eggs, beaten Salt & black pepper, to taste 1 large flour tortilla ¼ cup cooked breakfast sausage, crumbled 2 slices cooked bacon, sliced Instructions Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat. Sprinkle half of the cheddar cheese directly onto the pan. Pour the beaten eggs over the cheese and season with salt and pepper. Immediately place the tortilla on top of the eggs. Gently press down and cook until the eggs are set. Flip everything over so the tortilla is on the bottom. Sprinkle the remaining cheddar cheese over one half of the tortilla. Top half quesadilla with cooked breakfast sausage and bacon. Fold to close the quesadilla. Cook for 1–2 minutes per side, flipping until both sides are golden and crispy and the cheese is melted. Serve warm. #BreakfastQuesadilla #BreakfastIdeas #EasyBreakfast #CheesyQuesadilla  #tiktokfantasymoviecontest

d: Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

d: 🍗 WAFFLE MIX FRIED CHICKEN 🍗  INGREDIENTS • 2 large boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 cups waffle mix • 1 tsp salt • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp paprika • ½ tsp black pepper • ½ tsp onion powder • ¼ tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 2 eggs • ½ cup milk • Oil for frying HOW TO MAKE IT 1️⃣ Slice chicken breasts in half horizontally or pound them to about ½-inch thick. 2️⃣ Mix waffle mix + all seasonings in one bowl. 3️⃣ Whisk eggs + milk in a second bowl. 4️⃣ Coat chicken in waffle mix → egg mixture → waffle mix again. Press that coating on GOOD. 👏 5️⃣ Let the coated chicken sit for 5–10 minutes. 6️⃣ Heat about ½ inch of oil to 350°F. 7️⃣ Fry chicken for about 3–5 minutes per side, depending on thickness, until golden and the internal temperature reaches 165°F. 8️⃣ Drain on a wire rack or paper towels. 🔥 this time we served it on homemade burgers buns 🔥 it can also be serve with waffles + hot honey + maple syrup for the ultimate chicken & waffles situation. 🧇🍯 CRISPY. JUICY. A little sweet. And SO easy. 🤤 #ChickenAndWaffles #FriedChicken #EasyRecipes #FoodTok #ViralRecipes
zh: 华夫饼粉炸鸡 配料：2大块去皮鸡胸肉、2杯华夫饼粉、1茶匙盐、1茶匙蒜粉、1茶匙红椒粉、半茶匙黑胡椒、半茶匙洋葱粉、1/4茶匙卡宴辣椒、2个鸡蛋、半杯牛奶、煎炸用油 步骤：1.鸡胸肉横向片开或拍至半英寸厚。2.将华夫饼粉和所有干调料混合在一个碗里。3.鸡蛋和牛奶在第二个碗里打散。4.裹粉顺序：华夫饼粉→蛋液→华夫饼粉，裹好后要用力按压裹粉。5.裹好粉的鸡肉静置5-10分钟。6.加热约半英寸深的油至350°F。7.每面炸3-5分钟，视厚度而定，至金黄且内部温度达165°F。8.在烤架或厨房纸上沥油。这次我们配了自制汉堡面包，也可以配华夫饼加热蜂蜜和枫糖浆，做成终极的炸鸡华夫饼组合。外酥里嫩，有点甜，而且超简单。

Arsenio’s Chicken Alfredo Mac N Cheese 👑🧀🍗 Chicken: 1 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning 1 tbsp black pepper 2 tsp salt Cube your chicken, season it, then cook it halfway on the stove before finishing it in the oven. Roux: ½ cup butter (113g) ½ cup flour (60g) 3 garlic cloves 1 chicken bouillon cube, grated Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp smoked paprika Melt the butter, add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Whisk in the flour and cook for 60–90 seconds. Add the grated chicken bouillon cube, then slowly add your milk and cream while whisking until it thickens. Sauce: 3 cups whole milk (720g) 1 cup heavy cream (240g) 3–4 cups shredded cheese (340–450g) — fontina, mozzarella, cheddar Take it off the heat and add your cheese 1 cup at a time until smooth. Pasta: 2 packs Barilla pasta (340g each) Boil the pasta just under al dente, drain and mix it into your cheese sauce. Add the chicken and mix everything together. Put it into a baking dish and cover the top with extra cheese… measure that with your eyes 😂 Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes, then broil on high for 3 minutes. Plate it up and finish with freshly grated Parmesan. 🧀

Honey BBQ Chicken Tenders 🍯 My wife said that restaurant chicken is better than mine. I think she just wanted me to cook her dinner. The sauce takes these to another level, so don’t skip it 🙂‍↔️ 👉 full detailed recipes in bio 🔗 — RECIPE: Chicken (Dry Brine): 6–8 tenders tossed with kosher salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika. Rest uncovered in the fridge for at least 2 hours (overnight is best). Seasoned Flour + Wet Batter: Mix AP flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, cayenne, black pepper + pinch MSG. Move ~⅓ to another bowl and whisk with cold sparkling water until thin pancake batter. Double Dredge: Mix 1–2 tbsp wet batter into dry flour for craggly bits. Coat chicken: wet → dry → wet → dry (press to stick). Fry: 350°F oil for 4–6 mins until golden + CWISPY (and 165F internal). Honey BBQ Glaze: Heat BBQ sauce (Sweet Baby Ray’s), honey, butter, vinegar, hot sauce until smooth + glossy. Season to taste. Toss or brush chicken with glaze while it’s still hot. Comeback sauce recipe posted on my page! Finish: Top with herbs, an extra drizzle of sauce, & serve with ranch. Enjoy friends :) — #cookout #honeybbq #chickentenders #friedchicken #easyrecipe

d: Spicy Coconut Beef Broth Bowls 🍜 It’s super quick, low effort, but still feels like a high-payoff dinner, which is exactly what my Half Baked recipes are about: quick, easy meals that may not be the most perfected, dialed-in version of a recipe, but they’re delicious nonetheless and get the job done. d: Recipe Name Slow Cooker Brown Sugar Glazed Pork Chops Ingredients 1. 6 thick-cut boneless pork chops 2. 1/3 cup brown sugar 3. 1/4 cup soy sauce 4. 1/4 cup chicken broth 5. 2 tbsp honey 6. 2 tbsp olive oil 7. 4 cloves garlic, minced 8. 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 9. 1 tsp smoked paprika 10. 1 tsp garlic powder 11. 1/2 tsp onion powder 12. 1/2 tsp black pepper 13. 1/2 tsp salt 14. 1 tbsp cornstarch 15. 2 tbsp cold water 16. 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Pat the pork chops dry with paper towels. 2. Season both sides with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder. 3. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Sear the pork chops for 2–3 minutes per side until nicely browned. 5. Transfer the seared pork chops to the slow cooker. 6. Whisk together brown sugar, soy sauce, chicken broth, honey, Worcestershire sauce, and minced garlic. 7. Pour the glaze mixture evenly over the pork chops. 8. Cover and cook on LOW for about 3–4 hours, or until the pork reaches 145°F (63°C). 9. Carefully remove the pork chops and place them on a plate. 10. Pour the cooking liquid into a saucepan and bring it to a gentle simmer. 11. Mix cornstarch with cold water until completely smooth. 12. Slowly whisk the cornstarch mixture into the simmering sauce. 13. Cook for 2–3 minutes until the sauce becomes thick, glossy, and sticky. 14. Return the pork chops to the sauce and spoon the glaze generously over each piece. 15. Let the pork rest for a few minutes so it stays juicy. 16. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve with the remaining glaze. Follow this account for more tender, saucy, and unbelievably delicious comfort-food recipes.

d: Egypt’s ULTIMATE street-food: 𝗞𝗼𝘀𝗵𝗮𝗿𝘆! 🇪🇬 If you're heading to Cairo, stopping at Koshary 𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂 𝗧𝗮𝗿𝗲𝗸 is a non-negotiable food stop. This iconic multi-level restaurant in central Cairo serves comfort food with lightning-fast service, for around 𝗷𝘂𝘀𝘁 $𝟭! What goes into Koshary? 🤔  🍝 𝗖𝗮𝗿𝗯 𝗕𝗮𝘀𝗲: Macaroni and spaghetti mixed with brown lentils and chickpeas.  🧅 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗧𝗼𝗽𝗽𝗶𝗻𝗴𝘀: Crispy fried onions for that satisfying crunch, plus extra chickpeas served on the side.  🌶️ 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗦𝗲𝗰𝗿𝗲𝘁: A slightly spicy, tangy tomato sauce poured generously over the top before mixing it all together.  🥤 𝗣𝗿𝗼 𝗧𝗶𝗽: Wash it down with a local Egyptian soda like V Cola for the ultimate local experience! Have you ever tried Koshary, or is Cairo on your travel bucket list? ✈️ #EgyptianFood #Koshary #TravelEgypt #FoodieTravel #CairoEats
zh: 埃及终极街头美食：库沙利！如果你去开罗，一定要去Koshary Abou Tarek，这家标志性的多层餐厅提供闪电般快速出餐的舒适食物，仅约1美元！库沙利里面有什么？碳水底料：通心粉和意面混合小扁豆与鹰嘴豆。顶料：酥脆炸洋葱带来满足的脆感，旁边还配有额外的鹰嘴豆。秘诀：一种微辣微酸的番茄酱，在搅拌前大量浇在上面。专业建议：搭配当地埃及汽水如V Cola，享受极致本地体验！你尝过库沙利吗，还是开罗在你的旅行清单上？
